<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD file defines a standard AUR package for `sgdboop-bin`, a utility that integrates SteamGridDB assets with Steam. It fetches prebuilt binaries from the official GitHub repository of the project (SteamGridDB/SGDBoop) over HTTPS for both x86_64 and aarch64 architectures. The sources are verified using SHA-512 checksums, which match the respective platform binaries. The package installs the binary, desktop file, MIME info, and license into appropriate system directories using standard `install` commands.

The only post-install message is a user instruction directing them to visit the official website to enable the "boop" functionality. This is informational and not malicious. There are no network calls at install or runtime within the PKGBUILD, no use of `eval`, `curl|bash`, or obfuscated code. All operations are transparent and consistent with safe packaging practices.

The package depends on `shared-mime-info`, which is necessary for the MIME type registration, and it installs a `.xml` file for that purpose—normal behavior. No checksums are skipped, and all sources are pinned to a specific release version (v1.4.3). There is no evidence of data exfiltration, remote code execution, or unauthorized system modifications.
</details>

All elements conform to standard AUR packaging practices. The sources are pinned to a specific release tag (v1.4.3), and the use of HTTPS from a trusted domain (github.com) ensures authenticity. There is no evidence of dynamic content fetching, runtime modifications, or data exfiltration mechanisms. Therefore, the package appears to be safe and consistent with expected behavior for a prebuilt binary package in the AUR.
